metadata.name: vault
metadata.description: Недели 8–13 — vault, CPI swap и управление CLMM-позицией

instructions.name: create_vault
docs: Создать каркас один раз для пары (администратор, принимаемый mint).

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Зачислить фактически полученные токены и выпустить долю по цене до депозита.

instructions.name: initialize_market
docs: Привязать пустой vault к CLMM-пулу и создать второе хранилище.

instructions.name: open_position
docs: Пользователь подписывает создание своей позиции; средства не переводятся.

instructions.name: swap
docs: Обменять фиксированное количество основного актива, соблюдая минимум выплаты.

instructions.name: withdraw
docs: Сжечь shares пользователя и вернуть их долю доступных активов vault.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: SharesTooSmall
errors.msg: Deposit is too small to receive a share

errors.name: InvalidVaultBalance
errors.msg: Outstanding shares require a nonzero vault balance

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Position must belong to the signer

errors.name: InsufficientShares
errors.msg: Not enough shares in the user's token account

errors.name: WithdrawTooSmall
errors.msg: Withdrawal is too small to receive an asset

errors.name: TradingVault
errors.msg: Close the CLMM position and convert all quote assets before using shares

errors.name: OutstandingShares
errors.msg: A trading market can only be enabled without outstanding shares

errors.name: InvalidPool
errors.msg: Pool, mints or token vaults do not match the configured market

errors.name: ZeroMinimumOut
errors.msg: Minimum output must be greater than zero

errors.name: InsufficientAssets
errors.msg: Not enough assets in the vault

errors.name: PartialSwap
errors.msg: The swap must consume the full input amount

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Received less than the minimum output

errors.name: ZeroLiquidity
errors.msg: Liquidity and rent budget must be positive

errors.name: InvalidTicks
errors.msg: Ticks must be ordered and aligned to the pool tick spacing

errors.name: PositionMismatch
errors.msg: Position or NFT does not belong to this vault and pool
